newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Adsteam marine float possible in 1996/97.
newsitem.headline: Adsteam marine float possible in 1996/97.

text.p: The Adelaide Steamship Company Ltd said on Wednesday it could still float its marine operations before June 30 1997, after shareholders earlier approved the float proposal at an extraordinary meeting.

Adsteam's board later appointed directors to the proposed Adsteam Marine Ltd, and said BZW Australia Ltd and SBC Warburg Australia Corporate Finance Ltd had been appointed advising brokers to assist in implementing the float proposal, it said.
Adsteam chief operating officer David Ryan told a news conference the company was very well-advanced with the float proposal and was ready to proceed at reasonably short notice.
"We are well positioned to go before June 30 if an opportunity presents," he said.
